description: Ask TensorFeed a plain-language question about AI models, providers, or AI security and get the answer itself, not a list of endpoints. Answers from free live data: the best or cheapest model for a task (coding, reasoning, writing), the price, context window, and specs of one model, two models side by side, whether an AI provider or service is down right now, the latest AI news on a topic, upcoming model deprecations and shutdowns, and CVE or CISA KEV lookups including AI packages like vllm. Returns a one or two sentence answer, the supporting data, sources with a tensorfeed.ai page to cite, and up to three follow-up calls (paid ones carry their price and what they add). When no direct answer applies it says so and returns the best-matching TensorFeed endpoints instead. Free, no auth. Examples: "cheapest model for coding with vision", "is OpenAI down right now?". Use this first for any AI model, pricing, status, news, or security question.

question.description: The question, in plain language (300 characters max).

name: ask_tensorfeed
